Input roles: Image 1 is the exact accepted Round011 art and the absolute authority for Nyra identity, mature face, hair, cobalt/ivory/blackened-steel/oxidized-copper costume and equipment, one exact complete storm-shear weapon, studio lighting/background, framing, and ALL lower-body geometry. Image 2 is an ORIGINAL public-safe mechanics guide and the sole authority for the requested upper-body push-pull geometry; translate only its anatomy/force relationships into natural painted anatomy. Never render its labels, arrows, lines, circles, title, or diagram marks.

Primary request: Change ONLY the shoulder girdle, ribcage/spine, and elbows/forearms of Image 1 so the instant reads as a violent upper-body counterforce lock arresting the already-frozen upper-right blade mass. Preserve Image 1's lower body pixel-composition as closely as possible: same huge planted character-right boot, same compressed right ankle/knee/hip load column, same airborne character-left heel and exact toe skid/gouge, same pelvis location and leg silhouettes. Preserve the chest-height diagonal hilt, both gripping hands on the same continuous hilt, pommel, guard, full blade axis and upper-right blade center of mass exactly. Do not redesign or polish.

Scapular lock — intentionally exaggerate beyond comfortable symmetry: character-RIGHT leading scapula is strongly PROTRACTED and drives the leading shoulder far FORWARD and visibly HIGH toward the guard. Character-LEFT trailing scapula is strongly RETRACTED and DEPRESSED, pulling that shoulder far BACK and visibly LOW. The shoulder-height split must be unmistakable at a tiny thumbnail: leading shoulder at least one full shoulder-cap higher than trailing shoulder. Clavicles and upper-back contour twist steeply between them. This is push-pull across the shoulder girdle, not both shoulders reaching forward.

Unequal elbows — intentionally extreme: leading character-right elbow folds very tightly beneath/behind its fist, acutely flexed close to ribs. Trailing character-left elbow travels far back/left and low, substantially more open, making a long visible upper-arm/forearm chain that returns to the trailing hand. One elbow is short/folded; the other long/open. Never similar flexion, parallel forearms, or paired reaching.

Torso counterforce: keep pelvis frozen down-left while ribcage rotates hard opposite it and side-bends away from the blade mass. Deepen the spine into a large visible loaded C-curve, with one flank sharply compressed and the other stretched. Sternum is pitched and displaced away from the hilt; the chest must not sit centered under both hands. The blade mass line must read from upper-right blade through wrists, unequal elbows, opposed scapulae, twisted ribs, frozen pelvis, and into the planted right leg.

Hard freeze: exact Image 1 identity, expression and gaze; exact costume, yoke, copper route, capacitor, greaves, cloth, palette, materials, weapon construction and lighting; exact one-person/full-weapon framing; exact Round011 lower-body load and toe-skid; exact chest-height hilt and upper-right blade center of mass. Both complete hands remain visibly closed around separated regions of the same continuous hilt with plausible digits and straight loaded wrists.

Composition: native 1536x1024 landscape; one complete adult woman and one complete weapon; all head/hair, yoke, hands, pommel, guard/cage, blade tip, both legs, planted sole, airborne rear heel and toe fully inside the existing margins; pale warm neutral studio only.

Final-art prohibitions: no text, label, arrow, diagram mark, joint circle, force line, logo, watermark, environment, enemy, lightning, glow, particles, sparks, speed lines, motion blur, dust cloud, added design detail, extra person, duplicate/detached weapon, crop, penetration, or bare/fetish amplification.

Hard reject: paired reaching; level or quiet shoulders; both scapulae protracted; similar elbow flexion; bilateral upper-body balance; upright/straight torso; hilt centered on sternum; weakened C-curve; changed lower body or toe skid; waist hilt; blade mass moved inward; identity, costume, weapon, or lighting drift.

NEGATIVE-SPACE TEST A — low viewer-left trailing shoulder: viewer-LEFT shoulder/yoke center must sit at least 120 pixels BELOW the chin. Place it around x610,y430. There must be a LARGE unmistakable wedge of pale studio BACKGROUND between head/jaw/neck and the viewer-left shoulder/yoke. Viewer-left shoulder never touches jaw, neck, hair, or cheek. Retract and depress this scapula; costume and yoke deform downward/back with it.

TEST B — high viewer-right leading shoulder: viewer-RIGHT weapon-side shoulder center around x790,y300, at least 100 pixels ABOVE the viewer-left shoulder. Shrug/protract it strongly forward near the right ear. Shoulder/clavicle line rises steeply from low viewer-left to high viewer-right. This high-right/low-left order must read at thumbnail.

TEST C — external trailing elbow triangle: viewer-LEFT trailing elbow around x430,y565, protruding far DOWN-LEFT outside the torso and BELOW the hilt. Upper arm runs from low viewer-left shoulder down-left to that elbow; long forearm returns up-right to the trailing hand around x690,y500. Preserve a LARGE triangular area of pale studio BACKGROUND completely visible between torso, trailing upper arm, and returning forearm. Do not fill this triangle with cloth, armor, hair, weapon, or body. This elbow cannot cross the chest or hide inside the silhouette.

TEST D — folded leading elbow: viewer-RIGHT leading elbow around x760,y395, tightly folded directly beneath the high viewer-right shoulder with acute flexion close to ribs; complete right hand around x900,y385 immediately behind guard. The right arm is short/folded; left arm long/open. No paired reaching.

TEST E — two separated contacts: complete left hand around x690,y500 on pommel-side hilt and complete right hand around x900,y385 behind guard. Both hands and plausible digits fully visible and unoccluded on ONE continuous chest-height cobalt hilt. Keep a conspicuous bare cobalt wrap span between them, at least one hand-width. No overlap, fusion, hidden hand, guard clustering, or crossed wrists.

Torso force: keep pelvis and all lower-body geometry frozen from Image 2. Rotate and side-bend ribcage hard opposite pelvis. Deepen spine into unmistakable loaded C-curve: short compressed side beneath high viewer-right shoulder; long stretched side flowing to low viewer-left shoulder and far elbow. Displace sternum away from hilt. The upper-right blade mass must visibly route through hands, asymmetric elbows, opposed scapulae, twisted ribs and frozen pelvis into the planted right leg.

Absolute freeze from Image 2: exact huge planted viewer-right grounding boot and compressed right leg/hip load column; exact airborne viewer-left heel, toe-only skid and gouge; pelvis position; mature face/identity/expression/gaze/hair; exact cobalt/ivory/blackened-steel/oxidized-copper costume, attached yoke, protected copper route, capacitor, greaves and cloth; one exact full storm-shear, complete blade/pommel/guard/cage, upper-right blade center of mass and chest-height hilt; pale warm studio lighting/background; full 1536x1024 framing. No redesign, polish, new element, crop, or loss of frozen facts.

Final-art prohibitions: no text, label, title, arrow, force line, diagram mark, joint circle, logo, watermark, environment, enemy, lightning, glow, particles, sparks, speed lines, motion blur, dust, crop, extra person, duplicate/detached weapon, penetration, bare/fetish amplification.

decision.root_approval_scope: strongest bounded narrow shoulder-order/contact proof for fresh criticism only
decision.finding: Candidate 04 is the first bounded output to clear the viewer-left shoulder from the jaw and lower it beneath viewer-right while preserving complete separated contacts, exposed hilt, upper-right blade mass, dominant right load and rear toe. It still fails the judged Scapular Counterforce Lock because both elbows extend into paired hauling, the shoulder delta is modest, the down-left return triangle is absent, and the torso remains long and nearly upright.
